Constraint sets

Source: R/ir.R
consets.Rd

A constraint is a set membership: the expression f must land in the set, so x + 2*y <= 5 is written as 5 - (x + 2*y) in nonneg() — one sign convention rather than two.

Usage

zero()

nonneg()

indicator(bin, inner)

Arguments

bin

The binary ir_var() whose activity implies the inner set.

inner

The constraint set that holds when bin is active.
